Why Invitely

Everything your event deserves

From the invitation to the last check-in, we've built every tool you need to host flawlessly.

✉️
Beautiful Invitations
Stunning digital cards with your brand colors. Guests can view, RSVP, and download their admission card in seconds.
👥
Smart Guest Management
Import from CSV, Excel, or paste bulk text. Auto-deduplication, phone normalization, and detailed import reports.
📱
QR Code Check-In
Every confirmed guest gets a unique QR code. Scan at the door for instant verification with duplicate prevention.
📊
Live Analytics
Track RSVPs in real time. See daily trends, response rates, and check-in stats as they happen.
🎨
Custom Branding
Match your event's colors and style. Every invitation feels uniquely yours with full color customization.
⚡
Lightning Fast Setup
Create your event and share the invite link in under 3 minutes. No tech skills required.

Simple process

Up and running in minutes

No complicated setup. Just create, invite, and enjoy.

1
Create your event
Fill in your event details, pick your colors, and publish your invitation page in under 3 minutes.
2
Invite your guests
Share your unique invite link via WhatsApp, email, or social media. Guests RSVP instantly.
3
Check in at the door
Every confirmed guest has a QR code. Scan it for instant check-in — no printed lists needed.
